title: Breakfast at Alpenrose
rules: Photorealistic Bernese Mountain Dogs with natural heavy quadrupedal bodies, floppy ears and tricolor coats. No humans, human hands or upright human performances.
Sincere daytime soap comedy. Introduce the household through clear actions, pauses and reactions. No mystery reveal.
Objects move with noses, paws and mouths. Finish muzzle manipulation before dialogue.
Use the same character identities and assigned voices throughout. Only explicitly visible characters appear; references do not authorize adding the whole cast.
Only the scheduled speaker talks. All other visible dogs listen silently with mouths resting closed; no speech-like panting.
One winter morning in the same estate; fixed geography, lighting and props. Hard editorial cuts only; no generated fades, dissolves or extra angles.
setting:
One snowbound Alpine estate at breakfast, shortly after dawn. Old money, warm wood, restrained luxury. Soft amber interior light contrasts with blue-white snow outside. No time or weather changes.

The breakfast room is rectangular:

- **West wall / screen left in the master:** one inward-opening casement window, already open. Heidi rests on a low upholstered bench immediately beside it.
- **North wall / rear of the master:** an open doorway into the entrance hall. Otto and Bruno enter here. The exterior front door connects to this hall, a short distance from the window.
- **Center:** a low breakfast table. A small plate holding one cheddar cube sits at the near edge, reachable by Penny.
- **Near-right table corner:** Bruno’s oversized chair. His front half can perch on it while his rear paws remain on the floor.
- **Far side of the table:** Sadie, facing Bruno’s position. Penny starts on the floor beside her and crosses beneath the table toward Bruno.

The camera enters through the west window and settles into a master that shows the window at left, doorway behind the table, and Bruno’s chair at right. Subsequent angles stay on the same side of the Sadie–Bruno conversational axis. Heidi’s look toward Otto and Sadie’s look toward Bruno must match their positions.

**Prop continuity:** the window starts open, closes once, then reopens and stays open. Penny’s bowl starts beside Bruno’s chair, where he displaces it; Sadie retrieves it. The cheddar cube remains on its plate until Penny takes it in the final shot. Otto leaves his snow brush outside before entering.

HEIDI.identity: Owner of Alpenrose; Bruno’s grandmother; Penny’s great-grandmother. Elderly female; silver muzzle; narrow white blaze; burgundy collar
HEIDI.voice: Low, measured, imperious older female voice. Expects obedience. Affection lives beneath her authority.

OTTO.identity: Estate groundskeeper; trusted, familiar household staff. Stocky adult male; shaggy cheeks; ochre collar
OTTO.voice: No dialogue in this opening. Earnest physical reactions. His eventual voice is a warm adult male voice, never Heidi’s.

BRUNO.identity: Heidi’s grandson; Sadie’s husband; Penny’s father, as the household understands it. Largest adult; broad white chest; symmetrical rust eyebrows; navy collar
BRUNO.voice: Warm baritone, casually confident until questioned. Lumbering physical comedy.

SADIE.identity: Bruno’s wife; Penny’s mother. Adult female; slimmer build; slender white blaze; emerald collar
SADIE.voice: Precise adult female voice, dry and controlled; distinct from Heidi’s lower, older voice.

PENNY.identity: Bruno and Sadie’s young daughter. Clearly smaller puppy; broad white forehead patch; soft lavender collar
PENNY.voice: Bright young female voice. Direct and unembarrassed, without exaggerated baby talk.
